content.text: MongoDB is the leading document database for modern applications, offering flexible schemas, horizontal scalability, and a powerful aggregation framework.

items: MongoDB and Document Databases — Document modeling, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, and replica sets
Schema Design — Document modeling patterns (embedding vs referencing), schema versioning, polymorphic pattern, bucket pattern, and outlier pattern
Operations and Scaling — Sharding strategies, replica set operations, backup/restore, monitoring, Atlas features, and change streams
